It enhances the reasoning fidelity, context persistence, and verification disc"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ipline of LLMs (especially DeepSeek-V4-Pro / Flash and Kimi models) during complex, long-horizon tas"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ine of LLMs (especially DeepSeek-V4-Pro / Flash and Kimi models) during complex, long-horizon tasks."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## 🌟 Why J-Space?"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"During long multi-step reasoning, coding, and autonomous workflows, large language models frequently"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" suffer from four major inference-time losses:
1. **Working-Set Overload**: Too many active constrai"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"nts dilute attention.
2. **Representation Drift**: Global invariants, architectural definitions, or "},{"id":"p6s4","text":"goals gradually mutate across steps.
3. **Uncontrolled Retry**: Repeating failed routes without carr"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"ying diagnostic hypotheses.
4. **Premature Completion**: Mistaking fluent conversational output for "},{"id":"p6s6","text":"otheses.
4. **Premature Completion**: Mistaking fluent conversational output for verified execution."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"**J-Space** turns the model's accessible working memory into a structured, actively managed internal"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" workspace without changing model weights or requiring fine-tuning."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## ⚙️ 6 Core Cognitive Mechanisms"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Module | Mechanism | Impact |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Broadcast Hub** | Shared constraints deri"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ved once and broadcast | Prevents cross-file & cross-step representation drift |
| **Dense Track** |"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" `✓ / ? / ✗` symbol registers with lossless plain-text expansion | Enforces stepwise falsification &"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" rigorous self-verification |
| **Directed Focus** | Workspace limited to 1-2 active concepts | Elim"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"inates working-set cognitive overload |
| **Bridge Reasoning** | Mandates intermediate bridging befo"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"re conclusion | Eliminates conclusion-first rationalization |
| **Self-Monitoring** | Autonomously d"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"etects reasoning degeneration | Triggers rollback with explicit diagnosis |
| **Workspace Ledger** |"},{"id":"p9s8","text":" Persistent state externalization (`jspace.py`) | Maintains durable memory across task seams & subag"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"stent state externalization (`jspace.py`) | Maintains durable memory across task seams & subagents |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## 🚀 Installation"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Compatible with all operating systems (**macOS**, **Linux**, **Windows**)."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Method 1: DSH CLI (Recommended for Local & Server)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Inside your DSH profile or project workspace, run:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Method 2: Manual Setup (Local / Server / Container)"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"If you are cloning manually into your user directory (`~/.dsh`):"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**macOS / Linux:**"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"**Windows (PowerShell):**"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## 🎛️ 4 Runtime Modes & Activation Policy"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"You can switch the operating mode in the DSH Web UI (**Settings ➔ Plugins ➔ J-Space**) or in `~/.dsh"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"he operating mode in the DSH Web UI (**Settings ➔ Plugins ➔ J-Space**) or in `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **🎯 On Demand (`on-demand`) [Default]**: Automatically activated upon explicit user prompts or dur"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ing complex multi-step reasoning.
- **⚡ Always On (`always-on`)**: Global cognitive workspace inject"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ed into every turn context.
- **🤖 Auto (`auto`)**: Autonomously triggered based on task complexity a"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"nd code depth.
- **⛔ Off (`off`)**: Completely disables the cognitive framework."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## 💬 Usage Examples"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"In DSH conversations or Taskboard AI drawer:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- **Implicit activation**: In `on-demand` mode, the model automatically loads `j-space` when you ask"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" for architecture refactoring, bug tracing, or theorem proving.
